title: striped bedding
text: striped bedding. Bought two of these for a bunkbed we purchased... Twin over queen.  I love the colors.  Autumny... rusty... browns... Very good representation in the photo.  I actually like it person more.  Washed up beautifully and I think it looks more expensive than they were. I love quilts as they are easily machine washed at home - life is easier that way in my opinion. I am done taking comforters to the drycleaners. *Note... this quilt is not a "bedspread" and does not go to the floor when on the bed... the fall is about 6-8" on the queen and the twin... while the photo portrays the colors accurately... it is misleading the way they show it going to the floor.... I will update if new info seems useful.
